digest.component_or_area: eval-spec validation framework and CI gating
propositions: Strict eval-spec validation currently lives only in a non-gating GitHub Actions inline step in prompt-eval.yml and does not block Gerrit Verified vote, allowing invalid specs to merge.

Specs bearing a dataset field must pass strict validation (registered scorers, balanced dataset, non-empty gold_set), but this requirement is not enforced by the default pytest suite that gates Verified.

A unit test must be added to tests/unit/test_eval_scorers.py that globs all packaged eval specs and asserts both validate_eval_spec(spec) and validate_eval_spec(spec, strict=True) for dataset-bearing specs.
The redundant inline validation step must be removed from prompt-eval.yml after the unit test is in place and collects under the default (non-integration, non-external) pytest suite.
The new test must fail for any dataset-bearing packaged spec lacking a gold_set, confirming the strict discipline gates Verified pre-merge.
